about.text: Defendant-Appellant, Georgia’s Secretary of State (“Secretary” or “Georgia”) appeals the district court’s judgment, which permanently enjoined the state from employing several redistricting maps (SB 2EX, SB 1EX, and HB 1ES) in any future election.
